top_strength: Nicole established a clear, confident quid pro quo with time-boxing and a dependable-quote promise, and thoroughly gathered all essential logistics details (addresses, floors, property type, special items) before pivoting to the walkthrough.
coaching_note: Lead with the two-concerns question (on-time arrival or damage) before diving into logistics probing — this grounds the conversation in what matters to the customer and creates the opening for Step 3's promises to land with purpose.
